instruction: Add ~/.aws-bill-mail-body.html to the email draft as an attachment and leave the draft unsent.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 1: Attach HTML file instead of PDF. Same difficulty and pattern as original, just different file type. The verification script checks for .aws-bill-mail-body.html attachment.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH requirements - (1) HTML file attachment via has_attachment check and attachment filename matching, (2) 'do not send' via not_sent check (getter explicitly checks Drafts folder AND Sent folder absence at lines 100-119)

Correct semantic logic: Getter directly reads Thunderbird mbox files (Drafts and Sent folders), parses email content using proper mbox format, searches for attachment headers using correct regex pattern (Content-Disposition), and verifies attachment name matches .aws-bill-mail-body.html

Proper data flow: Getter returns dict with draft_exists, not_sent, has_attachment, attachment_size fields. Metric correctly compares each field against expected rules. Expected parameter handling is correct (metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule, no incorrect access patterns)
Appropriate partial credit logic: 4 requirements weighted at 25% each (draft exists, not sent, has attachment, attachment size >= 500 bytes) aligns well with instruction verification needs

Robust edge case handling: Getter handles missing/unreadable files gracefully, empty Sent folder (assumes not sent if Sent is empty), and falls back to assuming not sent if Sent check fails but email is in Drafts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add verification that attachment file content hash matches expected file to ensure EXACT file was attached (not just correct filename). Current size check (>500 bytes) provides basic content verification but not byte-for-byte accuracy
Minor robustness: Consider adding explicit check for Thunderbird profile path existence before attempting to read mbox files, with clear error message if profile not found
